audit_boundary: All nine ADR9 r2 TaskSpecs say to stop on start-identity mismatch, so allowed reads are successors and must not cross that result dependency. Root command exits use codex-events machine fields. Descendant wrappers are paired to custom_tool_call_output by call_id and require integer exit_code or exit_status. Collector reports do not decide the gate when every nested command has a machine-bound status.
